script_text: Stop, Aries: a hidden partnership truth could derail everything right now. In whole-sign houses, Neptune at 4° Aries opposes Libra’s Sun across your 1st and 7th, exposing tension between independence and commitment. Aries’s fire-element ruler, Mars, squares the Sun from 0° Leo in your 5th House, while Jupiter at 18° Leo sextiles Saturn at 12° Aries. Love warns against idealization: Neptune creates fog while Mars in your 5th rewards direct action. If single, attract someone candid who respects your fire; if attached, verify facts before replying. The Jupiter-Saturn sextile can carry a 5th House offer into your 10th House, provided the fee, deadline, and revision limit are written. Send the pitch; design, teaching, editing, or client coordination is favored. Unexpected blessing: a client conversation may become a paid contract for you. Follow for tomorrow’s reading before next week’s fire builds.
